translations.web: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and those who forsake Yahweh shall be consumed.
translations.bsb: But rebels and sinners will together be shattered, and those who forsake the LORD will perish.
translations.kjv: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake the LORD shall be consumed.
translations.asv: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and they that forsake Jehovah shall be consumed.
